report.summary: At t = 4.672 s (timing uncertainty about 0.042 s), there was an impact between car-2 and car-3. From t = 3.472 to 4.472 s, car-2 travelled at 50.6 km/h (90% interval 47.3 to 54.7) and car-3 travelled at 29.5 km/h (90% interval 27.7 to 32.0). For s1, the claimed speed for the white car is NOT consistent with the footage, compared with the measured 50.6 km/h (90% interval 47.3 to 54.7). For s1, the claim that the light was green cannot be checked from the footage, with 11 traffic lights in view. For s2, the claimed speed for the blue car is consistent with the footage, and the claim that the white car did not apply the brake is consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; frames the recorder dropped were placed using the vehicles' own motion.
Road calibration error: 0.481 m (how well the clicked road points fit a flat road); positions assume a flat road.

The momentum check after the impact did not balance (inconsistent): after contact the vehicles overlap in the image, so post-impact motion is not reliable. Speeds before the impact are measured separately and are not affected.
